scripts.validate: pnpm validate:package-identity && pnpm validate:brand-neutrality && pnpm validate:boundaries && pnpm validate:release && pnpm validate:release-contracts
scripts.deploy:docs:prod: pnpm guard:release:mutation && test -n "$PUBLIC_BUILD_VERSION" && test -n "$PUBLIC_BUILD_GIT_SHA" && test -n "$PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME" && pnpm --filter @appranks/ui-docs run build && pnpm --dir apps/docs exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:showcase:prod: pnpm guard:release:mutation && test -n "$BUILD_VERSION" && test -n "$BUILD_GIT_SHA" && test -n "$BUILD_TIME" && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @appranks/ui-showcase run cf:build && pnpm --dir apps/showcase exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env production --var BUILD_VERSION:$BUILD_VERSION --var BUILD_GIT_SHA:$BUILD_GIT_SHA --var BUILD_TIME:$BUILD_TIME
scripts.publish:ui:verify: pnpm guard:release:mutation && node scripts/release/verify-ui-dist.mjs && pnpm pack:ui
scripts.publish:ui: pnpm guard:release:mutation && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/ui run build && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/ui publish --access restricted --no-git-checks
scripts.smoke:showcase:local: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @appranks/ui-showcase run cf:build && node scripts/release/showcase-assets-smoke.ts
scripts.version:packages: pnpm guard:release:mutation && changeset version && pnpm sync:docs-changelog
scripts.release: pnpm release:preflight && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm publish:ui
